run_knn_evaluation: run k-NN classification evaluation on a DINOv2 model with specified train and validation datasets
eval_knn_with_leave_one_out: evaluate k-NN classification using leave-one-out strategy for CHAMMI_CP task 3 and CHAMMI_HPA task 4
eval_knn_with_model: evaluate k-NN classification on a model with optional bag-of-channels strategy and leave-one-out support
eval_knn: evaluate k-NN classification on train and test datasets with configurable k values and temperature
create_train_test_dataset_dict_leave_one: create a train dataset dictionary using leave-one-out method combining train and test datasets
